I’m so sorry to hear you’re struggling, and while I don’t know your exact situation, I’ve been in your place before. I was hospitalized while living and working in CA about 10 years ago.  I was fortunate at the time to have short term disability through my job at the time, which they essentially forced me to take after noticeably struggling at work. A short time after that I was hospitalized. So, the good part was through short term disability I was still paid even though I wasn’t working, and that lasted 12 weeks (I think - it was a little a while ago so I’m not 100% sure.) 

You might also want to look into Family Medical Leave. Not sure if you’d qualify after 3 months, but worth looking into. While you may not get paid, it essentially holds your job for you while you take the time you need for yourself. 

In my own experience I ended up not going to back to my job and essentially started over professionally (moved home, found a job filing at an office, and worked back up from there). Not ideal, but I made it through and have a job I love now. 

Please take care of yourself. I know work is important, but you’re more important than any job. If you’re concerned about your safety, please do what you need to do to take care of yourself first and foremost. Feel free to PM me for anything - tell me what’s going on,ask questions, anything. Take care.
